typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FailureMail as string (),
	FileExists as boolean (),
	FileMemberCnt_Invalid as integer (),
	FileMemberCnt_Total as integer (),
	FileMemberCnt_Valid as integer (),
	GRGR_CK as integer (),
	InboundArchiveFilePath as string (),
	InboundFileFullName as string (),
	InboundFileName as string (),
	InboundFileName_Invalid as string (),
	InboundFilePath as string (),
	InboundFilePrefix as string (),
	InvalidMemberTbl as string (),
	MarketCode as string (),
	SuccessEmailMessage as string (),
	SuccessEmailSubject as string (),
	SuccessMail_CC as string (),
	SuccessMail_To as string ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID_File as string,
		SBSB_ID_ODW as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT LKP.SBSB_ID SBSB_ID_File, SBSB.SBSB_ID SBSB_ID_ODW FROM EXTRACT.Mindoula_SMI_Members_LKP LKP LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC  SBSB WITH(NOLOCK)  	ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = 28 	AND LKP.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSBSB
OLEDBSBSB split(!(isNull(SBSB_ID_ODW)) && (SBSB_ID_File != ''),isNull(SBSB_ID_ODW) && (SBSB_ID_File != ''), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,Case2,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case2 sink(input(
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SBSB_ID = SBSB_ID_File)) ~> FFInvalidMembers
